translations.web: They shall teach my people the difference between the holy and the common, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.
translations.bsb: They are to teach My people the difference between the holy and the common and show them how to discern between the clean and the unclean.
translations.kjv: And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and profane, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.
